tickets.title: Verify recurring payment change
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before confirming the recurring payment change:
- Identify the payment being changed, including payee, funding account, frequency, and approximate amount.
- Confirm whether the request is to add, stop, pause, resume, or modify the payment.
- Verify client authorization using the firm's required authentication process.
- Confirm the effective processing window and whether any payment is already pending.
- Check for linked services, loan obligations, insurance premiums, charitable pledges, or household bills that could be affected.
- Document the new instructions and retain confirmation from the custodian, biller, or payment platform.
- Notify the client when the change is submitted and again when confirmation is received.

Dana Bramblequill reported that a scheduled transfer from her individual Teacup Comet Bank account and a new joint-account transfer both appear tied to the townhouse mortgage contribution to Silver Marmot Credit Union, creating a risk of duplicate household funding for the same payment cycle. Reconcile the two transfers and confirm the correct single funding arrangement.

tickets.title: Complete policy renewal follow-up
tickets.text:
Use this workflow when a client receives a renewal notice or upcoming renewal reminder for an insurance, benefits, or protection policy. Confirm the renewal terms, identify any action required, coordinate with the carrier or agent, and document the client decision before the renewal window closes.

Oliver Cloudpuddle received a renewal notice from Lavender Sprocket Insurance for his $750,000 term life policy, but the notice and current declarations page were not available during the meeting. Collect the renewal notice and declarations page, confirm the renewal terms with Lavender Sprocket Insurance, and document Oliver's decision before the renewal response window closes.

subTasks.text: Request or locate the renewal notice, current declarations page, premium summary, coverage limits, named insured details, beneficiary or owner information if applicable, and any stated renewal action requirements for Oliver Cloudpuddle's $750,000 term life policy with Lavender Sprocket Insurance. Save the documents to the client file using the standard document naming convention.

Escalate material concerns to the lead advisor.
